rebuttal_or_critique: I maintain my position that the current stance of withdrawal of accommodation is necessary. While I acknowledge the concerns regarding the potential for over-tightening, the combination of a 6.0% monsoon deficit and food inflation at 6.56% presents a clear risk to rural price stability and headline inflation. Given the positive output gap of 0.70% and robust GVA growth of 7.60%, the economy demonstrates sufficient resilience to support the current policy stance. A shift to a neutral stance at this juncture would be premature and risks signaling a dilution of our commitment to the 4.00% inflation target, especially in the face of persistent supply-side pressures.
